source_before_OOF: SOURCE_FREEZE binds all executable source, exact inputs and successful actual-prefix replay; SOURCE_PUBLICATION binds its remote commit before formal fits
population: 288 historical TRAIN recordings, 24 actors, two phrases and six emotions per actor; all genuine raw bytes verified
validation_and_test_policy: Do not load either; no tuning or checkpoint selection based on actor-OOF results
encoder: Official TorchAudio2.6.0+cpu WAV2VEC2_ASR_BASE_960H, frozen/eval, strict local-only verified checkpoint
encoder_pretraining_scope: LibriSpeech960h pretrained and ASR fine-tuned; not an emotion classifier or original v6 asset
prefix: One physical second from shared audio/video source origin, crop native PCM before resampling; reuse exactly identified prepared TRAIN cache
descriptor: 1536 dimensions: final hidden mean and population std; exclude CTC logits and transcripts
readout: Centered dual ridge on one-hot six-emotion targets; intercept is train class frequency
standardization: Per fold, mean/population std fitted on 23 training actors only; scale below1e-12 set1
folds: 24 leave-one-actor-out folds, sorted actor IDs; every held actor has12 examples, two per emotion
full_train_fit: One final fixed-lambda fit on all288 TRAIN examples; no fitted-training quality used for adoption
probability_mapping: Softmax of fixed ridge scores at temperature1; descriptive and uncalibrated
cost: New fits and actual forward probes in disjoint complete waited-worker envelopes. Reused feature preparation cost is separate known historical setup; no zero imputation for pretraining or missing history
admission: No original v6 task equivalence, complete historical exclusion ledger, strong-audio quality qualification, binding reference, or independent new cohort claimed
